name: Labor Payment New
query:
SELECT 
    lt.name AS "Timsheet Id",
    lt.employee AS "Labor Name:Data:220",
    lt.full_name AS "Full Name:220",
    lt.job_title AS "Job Title:Data:220",
    
    IFNULL(t1.total_hours, 0) + IFNULL(t2.total_hours, 0) AS "Total Hours:Int:100",
    (IFNULL(t1.total_hours, 0) + IFNULL(t2.total_hours, 0)) * %(wage_rate)s AS "Amount:Currency:120"

FROM 
    `tabLabor Timesheet` lt

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        parent,
        SUM(
            IF(morning = 1, 4, 0) + 
            IF(afternoon = 1, 4, 0) + 
            IF(night = 1, 4, 0)
        ) AS total_hours
    FROM `tabLabor Timesheet Table 1`
    GROUP BY parent
) t1 ON t1.parent = lt.name

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        parent,
        SUM(
            IF(morning = 1, 4, 0) + 
            IF(afternoon = 1, 4, 0) + 
            IF(night = 1, 4, 0)
        ) AS total_hours
    FROM `tabLabor Timesheet Table 2`
    GROUP BY parent
) t2 ON t2.parent = lt.name

WHERE 
    lt.from_date >= %(from_date)s
    AND lt.to_date <= %(to_date)s

ORDER BY 
    lt.employee ASC;
